primary_comparison: Each candidate against B on the same 45 reports; A is a second reference
failure_policy: Retain sampled failures with zero; no replacement or fallback
selection_policy: Per-project seeded sampling of frozen metadata; never inspect rankings or labels to select
resources: CPU only, saved rankings only; no model loading, GPU calls, encoding, generation or reranking

screening_rule.interpretation: Pilot triage only, not statistical significance or confirmed improvement; do not auto-expand

scope_note: Exploratory subset of previously observed development reports, not an independent test. Fixed choices informed by historical 180-report results. No parameter grid or re-tuning after seeing this pilot. Full/pool comparisons isolate candidate restriction from scoring.
